These pages reserve names the archive should be able to attach evidence to later. **They are not biographies.** This bootstrap does not assign roles, affiliations, or participation claims.

Each stub can later distinguish:

1. Documented role (cited)
2. Attributed recollection
3. Sources mentioning the person
4. Questions we would like to verify

Do not contact living participants unless a separately agreed research protocol exists. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/jordanforge-ca/csil-history/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
